message: Needless to say, I think you're right. You are raising perfectly valid concerns about not only how this specific conference was run but about the nature of the CCCCs as an organization. But the problem is that in the current political moment, I think the people who are running things-- again, not just this year but what seems to me the last few years, and I am thinking of the EC but also in more abstract terms "the field" in general-- are not interested in considering these concerns about how things are being run.
